integrity: The theorem and proof are explicit, a standalone numerical consistency checker is included, and no numerical test is represented as an infinite proof or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact cutoff is proved for the uniform-contaminated one-sided power-cusp generator on the circle. It does not classify all singular copula kernels. Exact closed supremum formulas are given at even lags; odd-lag finiteness and exponential bounds are established without a closed odd-lag supremum. Priority is provisional pending specialist historical review.
title: Arbitrarily delayed relative mixing in Doeblin circle-copula processes
